cleartext.title: Unencrypted connection
cleartext.body: The connection to {{host}} isn't encrypted. Your username and app password would be sent in clear text over the network.
cleartext.warning: Anyone between this phone and the server — the Wi-Fi operator, your internet provider, any network in between — can read your password and your calendar data. A Nextcloud app password grants access to your whole account, not just the calendar.
cleartext.remedy: Safer options: reach the server through a VPN such as Tailscale or WireGuard, or set up a free certificate with DuckDNS and Let's Encrypt.
